title: neadsr~
description: `neadsr~` generates an attack/decay/sustain/release envelope with configurable stage times, sustain level, and curvature; its default attack, decay, and release curves are logarithmic in level, with the exponential portion based on 60 dB. A nonzero trigger starts the attack, zero starts the decay/release behavior, and a negative trigger immediately jumps the envelope to zero.
